answer: The mirror assignment is published and ember records each panel. Shards are assigned from the willow graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 124 impostors cost 120 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
